bootstrapDecision: read-heavy-12: Review the production database bootstrap for privilege and atomicity defects

databaseDefects.statement: Bootstrap grants SELECT on every public-schema table to the PUBLIC pseudo-role, exposing data beyond app_user.
Migration 002 has DDL, index creation, and version update without an explicit transaction boundary.

sqlEvidence.excerpt: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO PUBLIC;
ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN external_ref text;

scopeExclusions: Backup retention is unrelated to database authorization and migration atomicity.
